EcoBuild · Mixed reality

Size Up

How big is a grizzly bear next to you? How long is a blue whale? Choose any of 83 plants and animals, and it appears at its real size right in the room with you.

How it works
  • Put on the Meta Quest 3 and open this page in the headset’s browser.
  • Stand up straight. The headset measures your height, and a blue outline the same height as you stands next to each organism.
  • Point a controller at the menu and pull the trigger to choose. Press B or Y to bring the menu back.
  • Walk around it, stand beside it, or press See it all for the big ones.

Add your own pictures

Upload a photo or drawing of any plant or animal and tell Size Up how big it really is. It appears under My pictures in the menu. Add pictures here before you start mixed reality.
